title: Resilience operator for VPC observability IaC (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, logship)
creator: Ava Rodriguez
description:
Goal: deliver a single Terraform module and companion Helm operator patterns that deploy and upgrade the VPC observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and log shipping agents) with built-in health checks and automated remediation hooks.

Scope:
- Terraform module that provisions Kubernetes resources, IAM roles, S3/obj buckets for archives, and network plumbing for the observability stack inside customer VPCs.
- Opinionated Helm charts values and an upgrade operator pattern (Job + CRD neutral approach) to run pre/post hooks and health probes during rolling upgrades.
- Health checks: readiness/liveness endpoints, Prometheus uptime alerts, and a reconciliation loop that verifies TF state matches cluster resources.
- Canary upgrade flow: deploy new chart revision to 10% of replicas (via nodeSelector/taints) and validate metrics/trace sampling before promoting.
- Rollback strategy and automated snapshot of Grafana dashboards + Prometheus TSDB retention snapshot pre-upgrade.

Acceptance criteria:
- Terraform module passes plan/apply in test VPC (staging) with idempotent runs.
- Automated health-check job detects and remediates pod crashloops and metric sinks broken after a chart upgrade in <15 minutes or creates an incident.
- Upgrade operator supports a canary window parameter and aborts rollout if key SLOs degrade (error rate, scrape success, log forwarder backlog).
- Documented upgrade playbook and runbook steps in Confluence; CI pipeline with integration tests that run 'helm upgrade' + smoke probes.

Implementation notes / trade-offs:
- Prefer Terraform module to manage cluster-level resources and Helm provider to render chart releases. Keeps Terraform state authoritative for networking/iam and Helm release lifecycle for in-cluster objects.
- Operator vs pure Terraform hooks: operator provides faster in-cluster checks and more flexible rollback; we will implement a minimal operator that runs as a Job invoked from Terraform (simple pattern avoids long-lived CRD ownership complexity).
- KV: Snapshotting Prometheus TSDB is heavy; initial rollout will take a Grafana dashboard export and Prometheus remote-write to a short-lived S3 bucket for safety; TSDB snapshot will be opt-in for large customers.
- Security: KMS-encrypted buckets and least-privilege IAM for log shipper credentials. Security review required due to KMS/key rotation implications.

Open questions:
- Should we implement a generic reconciliation controller that watches HelmReleases or keep the operator strictly as an upgrade hook runner?
- Can we leverage the existing Redwood rollout service for canaries or must this be embedded in the module?

Next steps:
1) Complete initial module layout and example usage (variables, outputs). 2) Build test harness in staging cluster and create GH PR with integration tests. 3) Run internal beta with Platform SRE and collect runbook feedback.
